title: Cancel the R&F ad order
content_data:
Use this endpoint to withdraw an R&F ad order to suspend its delivery. Once an order has been withdrawn, the status of the ad group will be changed to "**Closed**". Ads whose status is "**Deliverying**" cannot be withdrawn. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/adgroup/rf/order/cancel/|/v1.3/rf/order/cancel/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number
`adgroup_ids`: number[]|`advertiser_id`: string
`adgroup_ids`: string[]| |Response parameter data type|`fail_adgroup_ids`: number[]|`fail_adgroup_ids`: string[]| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/rf/order/cancel/ **Method** POST **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable | Field | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID | | adgroup_ids {Required} | string[] | ID of the ad group to be withdrawn (ID must correspond to R&F ad group). | ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code curl http) curl -H "Access-Token:xxx" -H "Content-Type:application/json" -X POST \ -d '{ "advertiser_id": "ADVERTISER_ID", "adgroup_ids": [ "ADGROUP_IDS" ] }' \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/rf/order/cancel/ (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable | Field | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | code | number | Return code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | | message | string | Return message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | | request_id | string | The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | | data | object | Returned data. | #| fail_adgroup_ids | string[] | ID of the ad group whose withdrawal request has failed. | ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": { "fail_adgroup_ids": [222] } "request_id":"12345678" } (/code); ```
